package.name: trnav_2ws_core
package.description: AMR Motion Core - platform-agnostic abstraction library (TrapezoidalProfile, TransientGuard, LocalizationMonitor, RobotGeometry, RecursiveMovingAverage, math_utils, ActionMutex) for trnav_motion_mux consumers. Platform-specific controllers/packer/ActionServerBase live in trnav_2ws_motion / trnav_motion_dd per ADR-012 (2026-05-21); kinematics (IK/BicycleModel) live in trnav_2ws_kinematics / trnav_dd_kinematics under src/Control/Kinematics/ per AD-012 amendment (2026-07-04).
